title: Duck Shawarma Tabbouleh Wrap
description: A flavorful Middle Eastern wrap filled with grilled duck, tabbouleh salad, and a tangy zesty sauce. Perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Season the duck breast with salt and pepper.
Grill the duck for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Let the duck rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
In a large bowl, combine the tabbouleh salad mix, chopped lettuce, diced tomatoes, sliced cucumber, and thinly sliced red onion.
Drizzle the zesty tahini sauce over the salad and toss to combine.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the wraps by placing a few slices of the grilled duck onto each pita bread, followed by a spoonful of the tabbouleh salad.
